one_month_reasoning: Inside the window to 2026-11-13: (1) settlement of the $2.0B unit offering on ~2026-10-16 (50M share-equivalents plus 100M Series C warrants at $69.46; src 1); the stock already fell 8.8% on pricing, so the overhang is mostly in the price. (2) Q3 2026 results, very likely in early-to-mid November: IonQ has not announced the date (no 8-K on EDGAR after 2026-10-13, src 29); the Quartr calendar via Bigdata.com shows 2026-11-04 (src 30). It is the first quarter with SkyWater; the FY26 $450-460M guide (src 9) implies H2 revenue of ~$310M, so a beat or raise is more likely than not but expected, and the first combined burn could disappoint. (3) The Elisity close (targeted Q4; outside date 2027-01-07, src 2) adds ~34.8M shares at the $33.07 floor. No strong directional call: a roughly symmetric distribution centred slightly below spot (median ~$31.0) with monthly vol ~27% (92%/3.5 plus an earnings day). Unchanged from round 1; the supervisor's findings concern long-run value, not the next month.

Peer multiples weight 0.

thesis_break_reason: Our floor at the horizon is net cash $3,256M + operating units $2,500M less the warrant claim, over 536.4M share-equivalents: ~$10.1. At $11 the market would value the computing roadmap at ~$0.5B, about the failure-weighted state of our tree, i.e. it would have priced the roadmap as failed. A fundamental break before then: the 256-qubit/12-logical system not commissioned in 2027, the 10,000-qubit chip formally pushed past 2029, IonQ dropped from DARPA QBI, or cash falling below ~$2.5B through extra cash M&A. Ordinary 92%-vol swings would not explain a move there.
